items.title: Finite locally free morphisms are exactly the finite flat morphisms locally of finite presentation
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies finite locally free morphisms with finite, flat morphisms locally of finite presentation, and records that over a locally Noetherian base finite flat already suffices. The proof works affine locally, where the morphism is given by a ring map and the three conditions become module-theoretic: a finite free module is finitely presented; conversely a finite, finitely presented and flat module is finitely presented as a module, hence finite locally free; and over a Noetherian ring a finite module is finitely presented, which gives the third equivalence.
